sources.snippet: ByT5 is a tokenizer-free extension of the mT5 model. Instead of using a subword vocabulary like most other pretrained language models (BERT, XLM-R, T5, GPT-3), our ByT5 model operates directly on UTF-8 bytes, removing the need for any text preprocessing. Beyond the reduction in system complexity, we find that parameter-matched ByT5 models are competitive with mT5 across a range of tasks, and ...

sources.title: [2204.03067] ByT5 model for massively multilingual grapheme-to-phoneme ...
sources.snippet: In this study, we tackle massively multilingual grapheme-to-phoneme conversion through implementing G2P models based on ByT5. We have curated a G2P dataset from various sources that covers around 100 languages and trained large-scale multilingual G2P models based on ByT5. We found that ByT5 operating on byte-level inputs significantly outperformed the token-based mT5 model in terms of ...
